hint.text: Direct speech must have speech marks at the start and at the end of the line of speech. You must have punctuation other than a full stop before the last speech mark. Reported speech has no speech marks, it just needs end punctuation at the end of the sentence.

instruction.text: Drag the punctuation to the correct places in the sentence.

atoms.b: ((“))What is the date today((?))((”)) asked Dan.
((“))We live in Manchester in a 3-bedroom House,((”)) Kim told us((.))
((“))My favourite colours are pink, red and purple((,))((”)) said Michelle.
((“))My dad said to wear a coat today. It’s going to be cold((!))((”)) shouted Olive.
((“))Sorry! That was an accident,((”)) she said((.))
((“))Hi, my name is Abi. It’s nice to meet you((!))((”)) she exclaimed.
Katie said that she was too busy to see us today((.))
Ollie argued that it’s colder in New York than Manchester((.))
